entities.name: José Correia da Serra
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Francisco Correia da Serra was a Portuguese abbot, polymath, philosopher, diplomat, politician and scientist. In some circumstances, he was also known as Abbé Correa. The plant genus Correa, native to Australia, is named in his honour.
